name: Upwork
description: Upwork lets agents search jobs and freelancers, draft job posts, and review proposals and contracts in the signed-in Upwork account. Each user signs in to their own Upwork account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find freelance React developers with strong reviews and a rate under $80 per hour.
Draft a job post for a two-week logo design project.
Summarize the proposals on my data entry job and rank them.

apps.name: Upwork
apps.description: Job and talent search, job post drafts, and proposal review, over Upwork's MCP server with browser sign-in.
